title: Rebecca I NDE 994
content:
I don't remember the accident; it was on the afternoon of a rainy day. I just have a very clear memory of being unconscious. There was wide blackness above me and I was going away from it, below it, as if I was falling. I wasn't sure where I was or what was happening. I remember the physical sensation of shrinking, and talking to myself. I thought it was like being in a funnel and I was going down, by the time I was in the very tip of the funnel I was quite small. I even said, ' I am the size of a pea now. Wow, I must be dying. This is really easy, it's so easy to die. You die in the blink of an eye; you can die without even knowing it.' Then I realized that I couldn't die but why was I dying? Then sounds and words from above the void came to me, such as, 'Internal injuries.' When I heard that, I remembered my daughter (five years old), niece (six years old) were in the car with me, and I couldn't die without knowing if they were ok. As I thought to force myself back up a blinding white light was below me. I had to struggle to get away from it and fight to get through the blackness. Then I got to the top, my eyes flew open and a man's face was above me. I demanded to know, 'What is happening?' He said, 'You have been in an auto accident and have internal injuries, we are taking you to the trauma center.' Then I started giving out cell phone numbers of my husband, brother, sister-in-law to him. I reached over and held my daughter's hand, then I passed out several more times but I never went back to the void. I got over all my injuries just fine and have only an enormous scar to show for it.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Described a wide blackness/void above her and felt she was going away from it, below it, as if falling; also described it as being in a funnel going down and shrinking until "the size of a pea."
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Falling/downward movement; physical sensation of shrinking.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Void/blackness with funnel-like shrinking; blinding white light below; forced return to body with eyes opening and seeing a man's face; later passed out again but did not return to the void.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experienced void/funnel-like descent and shrinking; heard words from above; saw blinding white light below and struggled away from it back upward through blackness; returned to body (eyes opened) without reporting arrival into another realm or encounters.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Physical sensation of shrinking while descending in a funnel-like void until she felt "the size of a pea"; heard words/sounds from above the void (e.g., "Internal injuries"); perceived a blinding white light below that she struggled to get away from in order to return upward.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I am the size of a pea now. Wow, I must be dying. This is really easy, it's so easy to die. You die in the blink of an eye; you can die without even knowing it."; "Internal injuries."; "What is happening?"; "You have been in an auto accident and have internal injuries, we are taking you to the trauma center."
